about: Vectors for accept(), the device check for a Pop Snip app, written by tools/popsnip_vectors.py: each case names its app, release, files, log, head, root records, revocation list and pinned keys ("release": the test release key; "other": a key that signed nothing here), the head and the list the device already holds (null: nothing), and the code accept() gives (null: accepted). Files are ASCII text; null files are not a mapping.
